entities.summary: Antonio Pucci was an Italian cardinal belonging to the ancient Florentine Pucci noble family. He was the son of Alessandro Pucci and Sibilla di Francesco Sassetti, and the nephew of Cardinals Lorenzo Pucci and Roberto Pucci.
